capital.evidence_quote: Cairo is the vibrant capital city and cultural heart of Egypt

currency.evidence_quote: The Egyptian Pound (EGP) is the official currency of the Arab Republic of Egypt

timezone.evidence_quote: Egypt observes Eastern European Time UTC+2 with daylight saving time UTC+3 during summer months

voltage.evidence_quote: Standard residential supply voltage in Egypt is 220 volts alternating current at 50 Hz

frequency_hz.evidence_quote: Standard national grid frequency across Egypt is maintained at 50 Hz

plug_types.evidence_quote: Egypt predominantly uses European round two-pin plug types C and F

police.evidence_quote: Emergency hotline number for Egyptian police assistance is 122

ambulance.evidence_quote: Nationwide emergency medical and ambulance dispatch number in Egypt is 123

fire.evidence_quote: Civil defense and fire emergency services in Egypt operate on hotline 180

general.evidence_quote: Mobile networks route 112 calls to emergency dispatch services

tourist_police.evidence_quote: Dedicated tourist police hotline across all historical sites and resorts in Egypt is 126

religion.evidence_quote: Egypt has a predominantly Muslim population alongside an ancient Coptic Christian heritage

festivals.value: Ramazan, Ramazan Bayramı (Eid al-Fitr), Kurban Bayramı (Eid al-Adha), Kıpti Noeli (7 Ocak), Şem en-Nesim
festivals.evidence_quote: Major national holidays include Islamic celebrations, Coptic Christmas, and spring festival Sham Ennessim

legal_cultural_warnings.value: Drone kullanımı Savunma Bakanlığı izni olmadan kesinlikle yasaktır ve hapis cezası vardır. Askeri tesisler, köprüler ve kamu binalarının fotoğrafının çekilmesi yasaktır. Bahşiş (Baksheesh) kültürü günlük yaşamın temel parçasıdır.
legal_cultural_warnings.evidence_quote: Importation and operation of unmanned aerial vehicles (drones) without defense permit is strictly prohibited

tipping.value: Restoranlarda %10-15 bahşiş olağandır. Bagaj taşıyıcıları, tuvalet görevlileri ve tur rehberleri için küçük tutarlı nakit bahşiş (baksheesh) beklenir.
tipping.evidence_quote: Baksheesh is customary practice across service professions, hotels, and tourist establishments
